tonight.headline: Down 36.1, and only Daniels left
body: Bad news first: the 21-point lead from Sunday afternoon is gone. Tuten played hurt and went down again in the fourth quarter (Yahoo 23 Nov 01:30Z) for 8.3, while Rice scored 11.3 on your bench. Likely managed 4.5. KEI returns finished at 114.04: Jonah Coleman 34.9 and Emmett Johnson 24.3 (league file).
Daniels needs 36.2 tonight against Cincinnati. His best game this season is 29.8 (archive), and ESPN gives you 3%. There is nothing to move: he is your only unlocked player and he starts.

case.label: The script that wins
case.body: A career night from Daniels: 36.2 or more, which he has not reached in any week this season (best 29.8, Week 5, archive).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing you can move. Daniels is already starting; Golden is on bye and Jacobs and Marks are out.
